description: "The History of the Proceedings in the Case of Margaret, commonly called Peg" is a historical account likely written in the mid-18th century. This work unveils the complexities of relationships within the family of John Bull and his sister Peg, highlighting familial disputes and the implications of managing their respective affairs amidst public scrutiny.
